label: heart-s2-c1

analysis.note: Ablations remove a child's readout from the logit (zero and mean ablation give the same AUC because readouts enter additively). Linear replacement = least-squares refit of the child's logit contribution on its own raw inputs. The nonlinear block adds +0.013 train AUC over the linear core; the heart-rate-reserve gate carries most of it (0.006).

resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Relays 3195 (thal:7, active 100%) and 3464 (chol, active 93%) are affine on the data, so each gate is effectively one ReLU. Counter-directional signs reported, not explained: cp:2 +0.40 and fbs:1 -0.31 in the linear core, negative chol inside the flat-slope gate.
tool_bugs: No v3 tool bugs met. compute_shap on all 242 train rows took about a minute. Input fan-out splits (-26, -15, -9, -20, -18) taken from the topology. The agent sandbox refused shell loops calling uv with variables, so tools were called through a small Python subprocess wrapper in scratch (same xn.py).
summary: Mostly logistic regression: 16 direct edges (logit SD 3.24; train AUC 0.930 alone) plus three additive nonlinear corrections (logit SD 0.95) to 0.943. Largest: a protective heart-rate-reserve gate ReLU(-1.52 - 1.50 age + 1.02 thalach - 1.56 thal:7) read out -0.61, open for half the patients without a reversible defect; then a flat-ST-slope gate scaled by oldpeak and down by cholesterol, and a convex two-kink oldpeak dose-response. Age and oldpeak act only through these gates. Same mechanisms as the generation-38 heart-s2 record, weights shifted by at most about 0.03 after retraining.
